about: Machine-readable section list for tools/scroll_map.mjs. Scan x ranges follow reference/scroll/sections.md section 2 (余辉's seven segments). Keys are S<n> plus an optional letter (S4b = the second part of S4, built after part 1 under its own key). folder = the sections/<folder>/ that builds the section, if any. area = the part of x that is mapped and built so far, when it is less than the whole section (tools use area || x).

S1.name: 郊野 · 古柳: the countryside
S1.x_note: starts at u 29050, not 28700 (round 2 Phase 0): the 望楼饭铺 shed and its customers (u 28250-29000) stay whole in S2; sections.md puts the boundary in a zone, 28700-29000

S2.name: 汴河 · 运河两岸: the canal wharves

S4.name: 城门口外: the outer road
S4.area_note: part 1 (2026-10-11): the ox carts, the temple, the courier post and the fortune-teller; u 12600-15500 (the palm-covered family carts, the wheelwright, the moorings) is S4b (outer_road_2)

S4b.name: 城门口外 (part 2): the outer road east, to the moorings
S4b.note: S4 part 2 under its own key (round 2 Phase 0), so part 1's map files never change; IDs S4b.<kind>.<slug>

S6.name: 城内十字街 · 闹市: the inner city

S7.name: 卷尾 · 赵太丞家: the end
